thread:
tom: Greenpipe POC kickoff — they sent a security questionnaire + ask for SSO (SAML), SCIM (one-way iso HR sync), RBAC by team, plus domain egress controls. They want to validate proof-of-domain by file or TXT. Who can take next steps?

mike: Hosted POC? Are they also requesting dedicated logs?

tom: Hosted. They want 60d audit logs during POC. Ops can enable but it's a billable item.

raj: SCIM defaults: 100 req/min per tenant. Deltas retained 7 days. We support bulk initial import. For RBAC send csv mapping or use group membership.

sophia: Legal Qs: encryption at rest, data residency (EU preferred), pen-test windows. Elaine: can you attach the EU hosting statement and SOC2 excerpt?

elaine: Yes — will share EU region hosting doc and SOC2 summary. BYOK is not available on Hosted. For domain proof we accept TXT or file upload to HTTP root, or org-level TXT for subdomain delegation.

presales-bot: Ticket POC-1766001234 created. Items: idp-metadata, scim-token, rbac-csv, security-docs, audit-quote.

mike: Price/promo: 30-day free POC credits. Extra audit retention is add-on. For Dedicated we can talk about committed XPU hours.

tom: Who owns the questionnaire? I can coordinate, but need the Meridian QNA example.

raj: I'll paste the Meridian QNA snippets for deletion SLA and SCIM rate limits.

raj: "Deletions: soft-delete for 30 days with purge on request within 72 hours. SCIM rate limits: 100/min with Retry-After. Backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s."

elaine: I'll upload SOC/KMS docs to the ticket.

presales-bot: Reminder: schedule kickoff: https://cal.redwood.io/poc/1766001234

tom: Thanks everyone, will follow up after kickoff. :thumbsup:
